title: The Epic Games Store's weekly free games for India: Knightica (usually ₹539) is free to claim and keep from 21:30 IST Thu 12 Nov to 21:30 IST Thu 19 Nov 2026; Alien: Isolation (SEGA / Creative Assembly, usually ₹3,325) and Mark of the Deep (Light Up Games, usually ₹880) are free from 21:30 IST Thu 19 Nov to 21:30 IST Thu 26 Nov 2026, per Epic's own store listing for India (16:00 UTC switch), reported by VGTimes, Vandal and GameGrin.
